dossier.purpose: MCP Inspector (npm `@modelcontextprotocol/inspector`, v2 line, 2.9.0) is a developer tool for inspecting Model Context Protocol servers. It acts as an MCP client and ships three front ends over one shared TypeScript core: a Vite/React/Mantine web UI with a Node (Hono) backend, a scriptable CLI (`--cli`: connect, run one `--method`, print the result with stable exit codes and `--format json`), and an Ink terminal UI (`--tui`). One `mcp-inspector` bin dispatches to them (README.md:3-15). It is not an LLM-evaluation framework. Facts relevant to the stated quality/evaluation needs: (a) the CLI can serve as a shell/CI assertion driver for MCP servers (docs/cli-smoke-testing.md); (b) the repo contains a bespoke, repo-internal skill trigger eval, `scripts/skill-eval.mjs` (`npm run skills:eval`). It runs committed labeled cases (`.claude/skills/*/evals/evals.json`) through headless `claude -p` (or `AGENT=copilot`) sessions and prints per-case hit rates, and it is deliberately outside CI and the local gate; (c) CI runs deterministic structural guards for those skills (`verify:skills`, a pinned `claude plugin validate`). No containerized end-to-end runner for Claude Code/Codex CLIs, no verifier-graded trials and no Codex reference were found (case-insensitive grep for `codex` over the repo, excluding lockfiles, returns no matches).

claims.claim: Ships as a single package, `@modelcontextprotocol/inspector`, with three ways to inspect a server: Web (Vite + React + Mantine SPA with a Node backend), CLI ('a scriptable command-line client for automation, CI, and fast agent feedback loops') and TUI (Ink).
All three modes run through one global `mcp-inspector` binary: `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector` (web, default), `--cli`, `--tui`.

WARNING: OAuth tokens, OAuth client secrets and stdio `env:` values are stored in the OS keychain if available; with no keychain (Linux without libsecret/Secret Service, headless/SSH, Termux, containers with a mounted volume) they go to `~/.mcp-inspector/secrets.json`, unencrypted unless a key is supplied.
v2 is the active line: development on `v2/main`, merged into default branch `main` at milestone releases and published to npm `latest`; v1 lives on `v1/main`, security fixes only, npm `v1-latest`.

Dev quick start is `npm install` at the repo root (postinstall cascades into every client) then `npm run build` (web -> cli -> tui -> launcher). v2 is not an npm workspace; shared `core/` is consumed through a build-time `@inspector/core` alias; every runtime dependency `core/` imports is declared once in the root package.json, so `clients/cli` and `clients/launcher` have no runtime dependencies of their own.

Docs index: a quality-gate guide (GitHub-CI-vs-local-gate split, supported browsers); a skill-authoring guide ('how to write a skill description that actually fires, and eval cases that measure it'); a CLI smoke-testing guide (connect -> list -> call -> assert with `--format json` + `jq`, exit-code map, non-interactive OAuth); an MCP-App review recipe (CLI-first -> one-shot web).

There is no aggregate root `test` script: `npm run validate` (fast inner loop), `npm run coverage` (per-file >=90% gate on lines/statements/functions/branches) and `npm run local:gate` (MANDATORY before pushing: every GitHub CI check plus one local-only check; also runs smokes and Storybook tests).
`AGENTS.md` is the contract for changing the codebase for humans and AI agents; procedures live as skills in `.claude/skills/`; `CLAUDE.md` is the Claude Code entry point and includes `AGENTS.md`.
All work is issue-driven; external contributions are accepted as issues, not pull requests.

License: MCP project is transitioning from MIT to Apache-2.0; new contributions Apache-2.0, documentation CC-BY-4.0, contributions without relicensing consent remain MIT; LICENSE carries the full Apache-2.0 and MIT texts.
A container image is published to GHCR (`ghcr.io/modelcontextprotocol/inspector`, linux/amd64 + linux/arm64) by the release workflow (linked from the README docs table).

integrations.cli: yes: `mcp-inspector --cli` (README.md:13). Methods include initialize, tools/list|call, resources/list|read|templates/list, prompts/list|get, logging/setLevel, skills/list|get, resources/directory/read, servers/list|show (clients/cli/README.md:111). Flags include `--format json` (single envelope for `jq`), `--strict`, `--verify`, `--app-info`, `--stored-auth-only` (clients/cli/README.md:101-131). Exit codes 0-9 plus a one-line JSON ErrorEnvelope on stderr (clients/cli/README.md:446-481; clients/cli/src/error-handler.ts:27-71). CI recipe: docs/cli-smoke-testing.md.
integrations.mcp: none found: the Inspector is an MCP client and does not expose itself as an MCP server (no production code under core/ or clients/ imports `@modelcontextprotocol/server`; only test-servers/src fixtures do). `.mcp.json:1-8` only points contributors' Claude Code sessions at https://modelcontextprotocol.io/mcp ('mcp-docs').
integrations.sdk_or_api: No published SDK/library: `core/` has no package.json and is not published (docs/architecture.md:9-14; docs/v1-to-v2-migration.md:46); the root package ships only the `mcp-inspector` bin (package.json:20-31). The web backend exposes an internal HTTP API (`/api/config`, `/api/mcp/connect|send|events|disconnect|auth-state`, `/api/fetch`, `/api/storage/:storeId`, `/api/servers`, ...) guarded by `x-mcp-remote-auth: Bearer <token>` (core/mcp/remote/node/server.ts:1-5,455-465,773-1402; AGENTS.md:672-680); it is not documented as a third-party API. The documented automation contracts are the deep-link URL and the `data-testid`/`data-*` attributes (clients/web/README.md:109-210).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code: no end-user integration, but heavy in-repo use. There are 11 committed skills in `.claude/skills/` (AGENTS.md:15-29), `CLAUDE.md` imports `AGENTS.md` (CLAUDE.md:1), `.claude/settings.json` enables the `playwright@claude-plugins-official` plugin (:1-5), and CI runs `claude plugin validate` pinned to Claude Code 2.1.250 (scripts/lib/skill-manifest.mjs:440; main.yml:98-114). `skills:eval` drives `claude -p` (scripts/skill-eval.mjs:550-589). Nightly `sdk-watch.yml` uses `anthropics/claude-code-action` with `--model claude-opus-5` and the org secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (sdk-watch.yml:177-304). The CLI is described as suited to AI coding assistants (clients/cli/README.md:488-492). GitHub Copilot CLI is also supported by `AGENT=copilot npm run skills:eval` (docs/skill-authoring.md:446-515). Codex: none found (no 'codex' string in the repo outside lockfiles; no `.codex/` or `.agents/`).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry, analytics or crash-reporting code or dependency found. A grep for telemetry/analytics/sentry/posthog/mixpanel/DO_NOT_TRACK matches only a local connect-latency UI hook named `useHandshakeTelemetry` (clients/web/src/hooks/useConnectionLifecycle.ts:65-98) and design specs, and the dependency lists contain no analytics SDKs (package.json:95-117; clients/web/package.json:36-53; clients/tui/package.json:30-34). Network use: (1) connections to whatever MCP servers the user configures (stdio spawn, Streamable HTTP, SSE), made from the Node backend, honoring HTTP(S)_PROXY/NO_PROXY (clients/cli/README.md:89-99); (2) OAuth discovery/token requests to the inspected servers' authorization servers, plus a best-effort RFC 7009 revocation request on CLI `--relogin` (opt out with `--no-revoke`) and TUI 'Clear OAuth state' (clients/cli/README.md:133-143; clients/tui/README.md:70); (3) the web UI page loads Google Fonts from fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com (clients/web/index.html:7-9; CSP allowance at clients/web/src/components/elements/ContentViewer/contentViewerUtils.ts:252-254); (4) the web client's seeded default catalog contains two `npx -y` stdio servers (`@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`, `server-everything`, fetched from the npm registry when launched) and a remote server at https://example-server.modelcontextprotocol.io/mcp (core/mcp/serverList.ts:1133-1134,1149-1166; clients/launcher/README.md:34-39); (5) browser auto-open on web launch/OAuth, controlled by `MCP_AUTO_OPEN_ENABLED` (docs/environment-variables.md:50). Local listeners: web 6274, MCP Apps sandbox 6275, app-origin 6278, CLI/TUI OAuth callback 6276; loopback by default, guarded by a per-launch bearer token and an origin allow-list (docs/environment-variables.md:15-31; clients/web/README.md:389-395). No account is needed to run the Inspector itself; OAuth accounts matter only for the servers inspected. Dev/CI-only: `skills:eval` needs a signed-in `claude` (or `copilot`) CLI and spends metered model calls (scripts/skill-eval.mjs:14-20; docs/skill-authoring.md:441-444); `verify:skills:cli` may fetch `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.250` via npx but needs no auth (scripts/verify-skills-cli.mjs:19-20,58-73); `pack:verify` needs registry access (docs/publishing.md:18); `sdk-watch.yml` uses the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY org secret (sdk-watch.yml:46-52).

entry_points.what: `mcp-inspector` bin (package.json:20-22). Parses a leading `--web|--cli|--tui` and dynamically imports clients/{web,cli,tui}/build/index.js in-process (index.ts:10-14,61-93).
`runWeb(argv)` (:60): web mode. Hono prod server serves clients/web/dist plus `/api/*`; `--dev` uses Vite (start-vite-dev-server.ts).
`runCli(argv)` (:1315): commander-based CLI. Bin wrapper clients/cli/src/index.ts exports runCli/handleError and self-runs when invoked directly (index.ts:12-23).
`runTui(args)` (:19): Ink TUI; tsup entry is clients/tui/index.ts (tsup.config.ts:75).
`npm run skills:eval` (package.json:93): skill trigger-eval harness driving headless `claude -p` or `copilot`.
`npm run local:gate` wrapper (package.json:41): machine-wide lease around the ordered stage chain `local:gate:stages`.
`npm run pack:verify`: builds, `npm pack`s, installs the tarball into a clean consumer and drives the installed bin (docs/publishing.md:16-18).
Composable MCP fixture servers (also test-server-http.ts, test-server-oauth.ts; 15 source files, 44 JSON configs in test-servers/configs/) used by integration tests and smokes.

code.architecture: Four clients over one shared source tree; not an npm workspace (each client has its own package.json/node_modules). `clients/launcher` is the tsc-built `mcp-inspector` bin that dispatches in-process. `clients/web` has a browser SPA in `src/` (components/{elements,groups,screens,views}, hooks, lib, utils, theme; 123 Storybook stories) and a Node Hono backend in `server/` (run-web.ts, server.ts, sandbox-controller.ts for the MCP Apps sandbox, app-origin-controller.ts, inject-auth-token.ts, vite-hono-plugin.ts, plus static/sandbox_proxy.html). `clients/cli` is a commander CLI (src/cli.ts, handlers/{run-method,format-output,emit-result,skills-verify,schema-lint-report,collect-app-info}.ts, error-handler.ts exit-code map, cliOAuth.ts). `clients/tui` is Ink/React (tui.tsx, src/components/*Tab.tsx, utils/). Shared code is in `core/` (no package.json; bundled into each client through the `@inspector/core` alias, docs/architecture.md:7-14): `core/mcp/` (`InspectorClient`, transports, fetch/message tracking, state stores, config import, and `remote/node/server.ts`, the Hono `/api/*` server the browser talks to), `core/auth/` (OAuth, enterprise-managed auth, CIMD, secret stores incl. node/secret-store-selection.ts and file-secret-store.ts, keychain via @napi-rs/keyring), `core/json/` (schemaLint.ts shared by web/TUI/CLI), `core/react/` (hooks via useSyncExternalStore), `core/client/`, `core/storage/`, `core/logging/`, `core/node/`. MCP connections are made from Node (web backend, CLI, TUI), not from the browser. `test-servers/` holds the composable fixture servers; `scripts/` holds build/verify/smoke tooling, skill-eval.mjs and the dependency/alert/SDK sweeps; `.claude/skills/` plus AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md hold the agent procedures and rules; `specification/` holds design docs. It is built on the MCP TypeScript SDK v2 packages (client/core/ext-apps) with Vite 8, tsup, Hono, Ink and Mantine.
code.packaging_and_release: One npm package `@modelcontextprotocol/inspector` with a single version (only the root manifest has `version`; the four client manifests are private). The tarball ships the built clients/{launcher,cli,tui}/build, clients/web/{build,dist,static} and scripts/install-clients.mjs, with no source maps (package.json:23-31; docs/publishing.md:4-14). Release is maintainer-driven (`.claude/skills/release/SKILL.md:32-47,207-243`): a bump + `npm audit` report PR on `v2/main`, a milestone-merge PR to `main` smoke-tested with `local:gate` + `pack:verify`, then a GitHub Release with a bare `x.y.z` tag. Publishing is automated in `.github/workflows/main.yml` on `release: published`. `package` needs build+coverage, asserts tag == package.json version, runs `pack:verify`, packs and uploads the tarball (7-day retention), and holds no id-token (main.yml:239-306). `publish` runs in environment `release` with only `id-token: write`, installs a pinned npm 11.20.0, refuses a tarball declaring `publishConfig` or with the wrong name/version, and runs `npm publish --provenance --access public --tag latest|next` via OIDC trusted publishing with no NPM_TOKEN (main.yml:308-428). `publish-github-container-registry` pushes a multi-arch (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) image to ghcr.io/modelcontextprotocol/inspector with semver + latest tags and an `actions/attest-build-provenance` attestation (main.yml:434-530; `gh attestation verify oci://...` is cited in a comment, :497-499). Actions in credentialed jobs are SHA-pinned and enforced by `verify:action-pins` (docs/quality-gate.md:48). No checksum files, SBOM or detached signatures are produced (grep of workflows/release scripts for checksum/sha256/sigstore/cosign/sbom found only npm `--provenance` and the attestation). The Docker image is a two-stage node:22-slim build that installs the packed tarball globally, runs as non-root `node` and has a HEALTHCHECK (Dockerfile:9-25,58,68-73).
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Vitest 4.1.11 (exact pin) + @vitest/coverage-v8 (package.json:126,135). Web has three Vitest projects: `unit` (happy-dom, tests beside sources), `integration` (node; spawns the real stdio test server; src/test/integration/**) and `storybook` (Chromium via @vitest/browser-playwright; 123 `*.stories.tsx` files with play functions) (clients/web/README.md:359-383). CLI/TUI/launcher tests live in `__tests__/` (CLI also spawns the built binary in e2e.test.ts); ink-testing-library for the TUI (AGENTS.md:404-408). Root tooling uses Node's built-in `node --test` (`test:scripts`, package.json:50). Playwright headless smokes run Chromium in CI, Firefox only in the local gate, WebKit in neither (docs/quality-gate.md:21,64-85). Approximate test-file counts: ~447 web (`clients/web/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}`, including src/test/core and src/test/integration), 31 CLI, 31 TUI, 1 launcher, 36 root `scripts/**/*.test.mjs` (about 546 total) plus 123 stories; `core/` and `test-servers/` have no in-place test files (core is tested through clients/web/src/test/core). Gates: per-file >=90% on lines/statements/functions/branches (cli/tui/launcher vitest configs; web vite.config.ts:267-280); ESLint `--max-warnings 0` with type-aware `no-floating-promises` (AGENTS.md:552,573); Vitest `retry` asserted unset at runtime (vitest.setup.shared.mts:4-35); guards verify:install-fresh, verify:format-coverage, verify:skills, verify:typecheck-coverage, verify:dep-lockstep, verify:test-timeouts, verify:action-pins (package.json:52) plus verify:build-gate, verify:bundle-externals, verify:skills:cli. CI (`.github/workflows/main.yml`) triggers on every push and on published releases (no pull_request trigger; lines 3-9); all jobs ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x. `build` (25 min cap): npm install -> `npm run validate` -> `verify:skills:cli` -> `verify:build-gate` -> `verify:bundle-externals` -> Playwright Chromium -> `npm run smoke` -> `npm run test:storybook`; `coverage` (20 min cap): `npm run coverage`; release-only `package` -> `publish` and `publish-github-container-registry`. Scheduled workflows `sdk-watch.yml` (nightly: files an issue per MCP SDK release behind and runs a Claude Opus analysis job), `dependabot-alerts.yml` (daily) and `dependency-refresh.yml` (monthly) file issues, not PRs. `npm run local:gate` is the mandatory local pre-push superset (docs/quality-gate.md). Evaluation tooling relevant to the stated needs (facts only): (1) Labeled-case evaluation: `scripts/skill-eval.mjs` runs cases committed in `.claude/skills/<skill>/evals/evals.json` (10 files; 74 first-move cases = 54 positive `expect:<skill>` + 20 negative `expect:null`, plus 2 hand-off `chain` cases in test-servers). Scoring is two pure functions routed by case kind, `sampleHit` (first move, 1 turn) and `chainHit` (ordered subsequence in strictly later turns, up to 14) (scripts/skill-eval.mjs:400-462). Each case runs RUNS (default 3) fresh sessions; the per-sample record is the in-memory list of `Skill` tool invocations with turn numbers, and the report prints one PASS/FAIL line per case with its hit rate against THRESHOLD 0.8 (>=) or CHAIN_THRESHOLD 0.5 (>) (:66,93,799-879). Nothing is written to disk and no per-sample score is exported (:942-958). A run that observes nothing (auth error, rate limit, missing CLI) is rejected rather than counted (`runRejection`, :351-359). The tool policy is read-only (`--tools Read,Glob,Grep,Skill`, `--strict-mcp-config`; :482-520,550-589). (2) Containerized Claude Code/Codex end-to-end runner with a verifier: none. The eval spawns a host-installed `claude` or `copilot` via child_process (:668-700), the Dockerfile only packages the Inspector, there is no `.codex/`, `.devcontainer`, compose file or Codex reference, and there is no grader stage beyond the in-process hit check. (3) Declarative CI regression gate for prompts/skills/agents: no config-driven gate exists. CI enforces skill structure only: `verify:skills` inside `validate` (frontmatter parse, explicit invocation mode, >=5 distinct positive + >=1 negative eval case per model-invoked skill, 4,000-char listing budget; scripts/lib/skill-manifest.mjs:34,251,308-382) plus pinned `claude plugin validate` (main.yml:98-114). Trigger behavior is not gated in CI (`skills:eval`), and no `.claude/agents` or prompt files exist to gate. Independent-observation tooling for MCP servers: the Inspector CLI with `--format json`, stable exit codes and a stderr ErrorEnvelope (docs/cli-smoke-testing.md), `--strict` tool-schema portability lint (exit 6) and `--verify` SEP-2640 skill digest/frontmatter checks (exit 7/8/9) (clients/cli/README.md:101-131,346-444).
code.dependencies: Direct dependency counts by manifest. package.json (root, the published package): 21 dependencies (@hono/node-server, @modelcontextprotocol/{client,core,server} pinned 2.2.0, @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps ^2, @napi-rs/keyring, @vitejs/plugin-react, ajv, atomically, chokidar, commander, hono, ink, open, pino, proper-lockfile, react, undici, vite, yaml, zod) and 14 devDependencies. clients/web/package.json (private): 16 dependencies (Mantine 8, dnd-kit, ace-builds/react-ace, react-markdown, etc.), 25 devDependencies, 2 overrides. clients/tui/package.json: 3 dependencies (ink, ink-form, ink-scroll-view), 8 devDependencies, 2 overrides. clients/cli/package.json: 0 dependencies, 2 devDependencies, 2 overrides. clients/launcher/package.json: 0 dependencies, 0 devDependencies. `core/` and `test-servers/` have no manifest (tsconfig only). Lockfiles: root package-lock.json and one per client (web, cli, tui, launcher). Engine Node >=22.19.0 (package.json:118-120). `verify:dep-lockstep` enforces one version per install-crossing dependency (docs/quality-gate.md:46).
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md: supported-versions table (2.x actively supported; 1.x security fixes only under npm `v1-latest`; <1.0.0 unsupported), reporting only via GitHub private Security Advisory (not public issues/PRs/discussions; the no-outside-PRs policy does not apply to security reports), and a checklist of what to include (SECURITY.md:5-53). Maintainers' handling is in `.claude/skills/security-advisory/SKILL.md`; accepting and publishing an advisory stay human-gated (AGENTS.md:371).

claim_checks.claim: `npm run local:gate` is the mandatory pre-push command and runs every GitHub CI check plus one local-only step (README.md:99-102; docs/quality-gate.md:8-25).
claim_checks.evidence: package.json:41-42 chains local:validate -> verify:skills:cli -> coverage -> verify:build-gate -> verify:bundle-externals -> smoke -> smoke:web:firefox -> local:storybook. main.yml runs validate (:96), verify:skills:cli (:114), verify:build-gate (:123), verify:bundle-externals (:134), smoke (:171), test:storybook (:175) and coverage (:220). claim_checks.claim: `npm run skills:eval` runs every committed case in a fresh headless `claude -p` session RUNS times and scores the fraction of runs where the `Skill` tool fired with the expected name; first-move cases get 1 turn, hand-off (`chain`) cases up to 14 turns scored as an ordered subsequence (docs/skill-authoring.md:13-47, 194-260).
claim_checks.evidence: scripts/skill-eval.mjs: agentArgs builds `-p --output-format stream-json --max-turns N --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Skill --strict-mcp-config` (:550-589); runPrompt spawns a fresh process per sample (:668-760); sampleHit (:400-406) and chainHit (:436-449, later-turn rule at :443) are the scorers, routed by caseHit (:458-462); defaults RUNS=3 (:94), THRESHOLD 0.8 (:66), CHAIN_THRESHOLD 0.5 strict (:93, :799-801), CHAIN_MAX_TURNS 14 (:106). Per-sample results are held only in memory (:942-949) and reduced to one PASS/FAIL rate line per case by formatReport (:820-879); no file or per-sample score output exists. Tests: scripts/skill-eval.test.mjs (51 test() cases).

risks: Evaluation scope: the only agent-behaviour eval is a bespoke repo-internal script, `skills:eval`. It is outside validate/local:gate/CI by design (scripts/skill-eval.mjs:14-20; docs/skill-authoring.md:441-444; AGENTS.md:337-342), is non-deterministic and metered, and needs a signed-in `claude`/`copilot` CLI. It keeps per-sample observations only in memory and prints per-case rates (scripts/skill-eval.mjs:942-958), runs on the host with no container isolation, supports only claude/copilot (:109), and is not in the npm tarball (package.json:23-31). CI gates skill structure only (main.yml:96,114); no Codex support, containerized runner or verifier-graded trials exist.

Roadmap, not shipped: assertion/conformance features that could act as a general CI gate for MCP servers (`mcp-inspector --conformance`, 'Assertions and CI flows') are marked 'design now, build on signal' in a draft roadmap (docs/inspector-roadmap-2026-h2.md:9,137-140,290-293,439-444). At 2.9.0 assertions are composed by hand from `--format json`, `jq` and exit codes (docs/cli-smoke-testing.md:87-199).

Maintenance model: no external pull requests are accepted (CONTRIBUTING.md:7-13,37-49; .github/pull_request_template.md:4-10); the project reports 265 of 268 merged PRs since v2.0.0 as agent-authored with one maintainer account opening nearly all (docs/ai-software-factory.md:23-31,44-48); releases are roughly weekly (:46), so CI use should pin an exact version (docs/cli-smoke-testing.md:24-28); v1 is security-fixes-only (SECURITY.md:7-14,20-28).

Secrets at rest: with no reachable OS keychain the Inspector falls back automatically to `~/.mcp-inspector/secrets.json`, plaintext unless a key is configured (README.md:18; docs/secret-storage.md:44-45; core/auth/node/secret-store-selection.ts:5-40). `headers` in mcp.json are stored as written (docs/secret-storage.md:18); CLI `servers/show` does not scrub credentials embedded in `url` or stdio `args` (clients/cli/README.md:150); stdio servers run as the same user and can read the secrets file (docs/secret-storage.md:107).

Web backend exposure and egress: the backend spawns processes on request; `GET /` embeds the API token in the HTML and a request with no `Origin` header skips the origin allow-list, so the token is the only guard for non-browser clients (docs/docker.md:33). All-interfaces binding is an opt-in (`DANGEROUSLY_BIND_ALL_INTERFACES`), auth can be switched off (`DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH`) (docs/environment-variables.md:19-21), and the docs describe `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` for self-signed servers, which disables TLS verification process-wide (:121-127). The web UI loads Google Fonts from third-party hosts at page load (clients/web/index.html:7-9).

Platform and CI coverage: every CI job runs on ubuntu-latest (main.yml:56,192,240,309,435), with no macOS, Windows or WSL runner although code has darwin/win32 branches (scripts/lib/pty.mjs:46; clients/cli/__tests__/windows-path-argv.test.ts). Firefox smokes are local-only and WebKit fails two of three smokes for unidentified reasons (docs/quality-gate.md:21,75). The Docker image build/HEALTHCHECK runs only in the release-triggered job (main.yml:434-491), not on push. The Node >=22.19.0 floor is only an npm `engines` warning unless engine-strict is set (package.json:118-120; docs/v1-to-v2-migration.md:33).

Docs drift (prefer code): docs/skill-authoring.md cites ~63 first-move cases and 18 negatives (:190,362,518) while the committed evals hold 74 first-move cases (20 negative) plus 2 chain cases; docs/v1-to-v2-migration.md says CLI exit codes `0`-`5` (:23) vs 0-9 in clients/cli/src/error-handler.ts:27-71, and a 'dynamic' sandbox port (:19) vs the fixed default 6275 (docs/environment-variables.md:29).

Licensing and release integrity: the license is mixed and transitional (Apache-2.0 for new contributions, MIT for earlier ones lacking relicensing consent, CC-BY-4.0 for docs; LICENSE:1-5,212-216; README.md:116), and package.json declares only 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE', not an SPDX id (package.json:17). Release integrity rests on npm provenance and a GHCR build-provenance attestation (main.yml:428,526-530); no checksum files, SBOM or detached signatures were found.
